entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-08
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Blurry text above LightBulb preview #80181
  • Extensions: AssociatedExtensionImplementation API proposal #80167
    Next

Closed

  • `StringSyntaxAttribute` is not respected when passing a collection expression as an argument to a method #80179
  • csharp_using_directive_placement = outside_namespace should allow alias definitions inside namespace #80180
  • "Unassigned local variable" is reported for a variable, which is always assigned #80172
  • Removing CS0718 error that is an "artificial" constraint on the Type system. #80173
  • Corner-case in which “Remove unnecessary parentheses” breaks the code #80175
  • IDE0071 should suggest removing ToString on {ReadOnly}Span<char> for .NET 6+ #80132
    Backlog
  • Erroneous `IDE0040` raised on struct inside interface w/ `for_non_interface_members` #80169

PullRequests

Created

  • Reduce allocations in InlineHintHelpers.GetDescriptionAsync #80185
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Fix blurry text in LightBulb preview by changing TextFormattingMode to Ideal #80182
    Needs UX Triage
  • Move static members to another type - qualifies static member references in the moved members #80178
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Remove 'filters' from IDiagService and make it a pure data api. #80177
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Extensions: add SyntaxGenerator support and AssociatedExtensionImplementation API #80170
    Area-IDE, Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Needs API Review, VSCode

Merged

  • FailFast if the MEF composition is clearly broken #80186
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Move brace adjustment on enter to on auto insert in LSP #80075
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Support StringSyntax classification of CollectionExpression elements #80183
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Move 'ForceDiagnosticAnalyzers' back to IDiagnosticService. #80176
    Area-Analyzers, VSCode, Next
  • Call through diagnostic service #80174
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Avoid throwing when obsolete overload of GetUpdatesAsync is invoked with empty array #80161
    Area-Interactive, Next
  • Pin MessagePack version #80157
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Remove option to disable diagnostics #80166
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Use helper method #80171
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Bump patch version of MSBuild packages #80156
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Include category in Hot Reload log messages #80160
    Area-Interactive, VSCode, Next
  • IDE0071 should suggest removing ToString on {ReadOnly}Span<char> for .NET 6+ #80137
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode, Next
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #80168
    Area-Infrastructure, Next

Updated

  • Ensure that refkinds are rewritten for complex methods #79916
    Area-Compilers
  • Runtime-async ref local hoisting #80093
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Fall back to `dotnet exec` if apphost does not exist #80153
    Area-Compilers
  • Break cycle for lambda using field keyword with inferred return type #79995
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Field Keyword
  • Reference specific MS.Build.Tasks.Core version #80158
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Extensions: DocumentationCommentId and ExtensionGroupingName/ExtensionMarkerName APIs #80164
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Propagate `params` to lambdas and local functions #79880
    Area-Compilers
  • Reduce allocations in AssemblySymbol.GetTopLevelTypeByMetadataName #79810
    Area-Compilers
  • MS.CA.VB resources cleanup #80098
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • More MS.CA.CSharp resource cleanup #80100
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Reduce allocations in AnalyzerDriver.TryExecuteSymbolEndActions #79855
    Area-Analyzers
  • Reduce alllocations in AnalyzerExecutor.GetAddDiagnostic #79657
    Area-Analyzers
  • Remove CompilationPair abstraction in diagnostic analyzer subsystem. #80086
    Area-Analyzers, VSCode
  • [release/dev17.12] Update dependencies to ensure coherency #79938
